mechanism_claims.claim_text: The selected peptides bind porcine aminopeptidase N and reduce TGEV infection in ST cells, supporting receptor-binding/entry-interference context rather than a fully mapped structural mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The local paper does not provide structural binding-site validation or exact tabular EC50 values; mechanism should remain entry-interference context with cautions.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper proposes a TxxF-related motif similarity between selected peptides and TGEV S protein; this is sequence-motif support, not direct proof of the receptor-binding domain.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Peptides S/H/F and TGEV spike protein PUR46-MAD
mechanism_claims.limitations: Motif matching is hypothesis-generating and should not be promoted to a direct mechanism without additional structural or mutational evidence.
